messages:
alice_dev: Heads-up — after onboarding quasar-3 we saw p95/p99 regressions for very long inputs (>40k chars). Customers report timeouts and high tail latency. :worried:
ben_support: Which customers/requests? any common pattern?
alice_dev: Mostly large summarization jobs and a few chat sessions with long message histories. Repro case attached below (includes lots of emoji + mixed scripts).
ben_support: Can you paste a minimal repro curl?
alice_dev: Sure — this hits hosted API with model=quasar-3 and a ~45k char system+history payload:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"quasar-3","input":"<LONG_PROMPT_WITH_EMOJI_AND_CJK>..." , "max_tokens":2048}'
```
carla_sre: Observed the same p99 spike in infra metrics: GPU utilization normal, but per-request CPU pre-tokenize time jumped and KV-cache fill latency spiked. Attaching tail of logs:
```
[2026-03-16T14:02:13Z] trace=tx-9a8c tokenizer_time_ms=3120 kvcache_fetch_ms=840 runtime_token_ms=4 total_ms=4136
[2026-03-16T14:02:14Z] trace=tx-9a9d tokenizer_time_ms=2890 kvcache_fetch_ms=910 runtime_token_ms=5 total_ms=3805
```
carla_sre: Looks like tokenization stage is dominating for these requests, not the model forward pass.
dave_infra: Any changes in tokenizer config for quasar-3 onboarding? new merges / normalization?
alice_dev: Yes — we enabled the experimental emoji-aware BPE variant (tokenizer=quasar-bpe-emoji-v2) to reduce token growth for emoji. Works on short inputs, but not stress-tested for huge mixed-language docs.
eve_repl: I can repro locally: feed a long doc with dense emoji clusters -> token count balloons unexpectedly and tokenization time grows superlinearly. P95 jumps from ~180ms to ~2.9s.
ben_support: Ok — immediate mitigation options? Rollback tokenizer, throttling, or fallback model?
carla_sre: Quick mitigations I propose: 1) Roll tokenizer back to quasar-bpe-v1 for onboarded hosts via routing override, 2) Enable prefix KV-cache warmup for multi-chunk streams, 3) Canary a tokenization fix branch on a small subset of traffic.
alice_dev: Tried 1) in a dev canary — routing override to tokenizer=v1 reduced p99 dramatically for long docs. Can we push that as an emergency routing policy? :thumbsup:
dave_infra: I can push a routing policy that pins tokenizer=v1 for quasar-3 on the hosted pool for 10%->100% traffic. Will add an automatic rollback after 30m if errors increase.
eve_repl: I also have a patch that normalizes emoji sequences before BPE which prevents the explosion. Need QA on edge unicode cases.
ben_support: Action items: Dave — deploy routing override canary now. Carla/Alice — capture a reproducible test corpus and perf runs (with and without emoji-norm). Eve — coord with research to validate emoji-normalize patch accuracy. I'll notify customer CSMs.
opsbot: deploybot: routing policy "quasar3-tokenizer-emergency-pin" created and applied to 10% of traffic at 2026-03-16T14:18:20Z.
alice_dev: Thanks — initial canary 10% showed p99 drop to baseline within 5 minutes. Will monitor for 30m and then ramp. :eyes:
carla_sre: Logged a postmortem ticket under ENG-1229 capturing root cause (emoji clustering + bpe-v2 heuristics) and mitigation plan (rollback, token-normalize, comprehensive long-doc perf tests).
ben_support: Great. Keep thread updated with ramp results and any customer escalations.
